chapterInfo.content:
10
Kɔkɔbɔ wɔ Abosonsom ho
1 # Eks 13.21; 14.22 Anuanom, mempɛ sɛ mede sie mo sɛ yɛn agyanom nyinaa hyɛɛ mununkum no ase, na wɔn nyinaa faa ɛpo no mu, 2na wɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa asu too Mose so, mununkum ne ɛpo no mu, 3#Eks 16.4; 16.35; Deut 8.3 na wɔn nyinaa dii honhom fam aduane korɔ, 4#Eks 17.6 na wɔn nyinaa nom honhom fam anonneɛ korɔ, na wɔnom firii honhom fam botan a na ɛdi wɔn akyire no mu; na ɔbotan no ne Kristo.
5 # Num 14.23; 14.30 Nanso wɔn mu fa kɛseɛ no ara ansɔ Nyankopɔn ani; na wɔdwɛree wɔn serɛ so hɔ. 6#Num 11.4; 11.34 Na wɔde yeinom ayɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama yɛn, na yɛn kɔn annɔ bɔne sɛdeɛ wɔn kɔn dɔeɛ no. 7#Eks 32.6 Afei monnyɛ abosonsomfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom yɛeɛ no, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Nkurɔfoɔ no tenaa ase didii, nomee, na wɔsɔre goroe. 8#Num 25.1; 25.9 Nso mommma yɛmmmɔ adwaman sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom bɔeɛ na wɔn mu mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa totɔɔ da koro no. 9#Num 21.5-6 Nso mommma yɛnnsɔ Kristo#10.9 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye tomu binom ka sɛAwurade nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom yɛeɛ, na awɔ kunkumm wɔn no. 10#Num 14.2; 14.36-37; Heb 3.11; 3.17 Nso monnnwiinwii sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom nwiinwiiɛ na ɔsɛefoɔ no bɛsɛee wɔn no. 11Na yeinom nyinaa siiɛ, na ayɛ kɔkɔbɔ ama wɔn, na wɔatwerɛ no sɛ afotuo ama yɛn a wiase berɛ awieeɛ ato yɛn yi.
12Enti deɛ ɛyɛ no sɛ ɔgyina hɔ no nhwɛ yie na wanhwe ase. 13Sɔhwɛ biara ntoo mo, gye deɛ ɛyɛ nipa deɛ; na Onyankopɔn yɛ nokwafoɔ a ɔremma wɔnsɔ mo nhwɛ mmoro deɛ mobɛtumi soɔ, na mmom ɔbɛma kwan a mode bɛfiri sɔhwɛ no mu abɛda ho, na moatumi agyina.
14 # 1 Yoh 5.21 Enti, m’adɔfo, monnwane mfiri abosonsom ho, 15Mene mo kasa sɛ animdefoɔ. Mommu deɛ mereka yi ho atɛn. 16#Mat 26.26-27; Aso 2.42 Nhyira kuruwa a yɛhyira soɔ no nyɛ Kristo mogya no ayɔnkoyɛ anaa? Paanoo a yɛbubuo no nyɛ Kristo nipadua ayɔnkoyɛ anaa?
17 # Rom 12.5; 1 Ko 12.27 Ɛnam sɛ paanoo no yɛ baako nti yɛn a yɛyɛ bebree no yɛ nipadua baako; na yɛn nyinaa di paanoo baako no bi. 18#Lew 7.6; 7.15 Monhwɛ honam fam Israel; ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔdi afɔdeɛ aduane no na wɔne afɔrebukyia no wɔ ayɔnkoyɛ anaa? 19#1 Ko 8.4 Afei mese deɛn? Sɛ abosom afɔdeɛ yɛ biribie anaasɛ ɔbosom yɛ biribie? 20#Lew 17.7; Deut 32.17; Dwom 106.37; Adi 9.20 Dabi, na mmom mese, afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ no, wɔbɔ ma ahonhommɔne, na ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn, na mempɛ sɛ mo ne ahonhommɔne nya ayɔnkoyɛ. 21#2 Ko 6.15-16 Montumi nnom Awurade kuruwa ano ne ahonhommɔne kuruwa ano; montumi nnidi Awurade pono so ne ahonhommɔne pono so. 22Anaasɛ yɛrehyɛ Awurade ama no atwe ninkunu anaa? Yɛn ho yɛ den kyɛne no anaa?
Onuadɔ bɔ Kristofoɔ ahofadie ho ban
23 # 1 Ko 6.12 Nnoɔma nyinaa ho da kwan, na ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na ɛboa; nnoɔma nyinaa ho da kwan, na ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na ɛma nkɔsoɔ. 24#1 Ko 10.33; Rom 15.2 Obiara nnhwehwɛ ɔno ara ne yiedie, na mmom ɔnhwehwɛ ne yɔnko yiedie. 25#Rom 14.2-10; 14.22 Deɛ wɔtɔn no namdwa ase nyinaa, monni, na ahonim nti mommmisabisa ho asɛm! 26#Dwom 24.1 Na asase ne deɛ ahyɛ so ma nyinaa yɛ Awurade dea. 27Na sɛ wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no mu bi hyia mo adidi, na mopɛ sɛ mokorɔ a, deɛ wɔde bɛsi mo anim biara, monni, na ahonim nti, mommmisabisa ho asɛm! 28#1 Ko 8.7 Na sɛ obi se mo sɛ: Yei yɛ ɔbosom afɔdeɛ a, deɛ ɔkyerɛeɛ no ne ahonim nti, monnni. 29Sɛ meka sɛ ahonim a, nyɛ wo deɛ, na mene onii no deɛ; na adɛn na obi ahonim bɛbu me ahofadie atɛn? 30#1 Ti 4.4 Na sɛ mede aseda medi a, adɛn nti na wɔbɛbɔ me dimmɔne deɛ meda ɛso aseɛ ho? 31#Kol 3.17 Enti sɛ modidi oo, monom oo, moyɛ biribiara oo, monyɛ ne nyinaa nhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.
Abrabɔ pa ho afotuo
32 # Rom 14.13 Monnyɛ deɛ ɛto Yudafoɔ anaa Helafoɔ anaa Nyankopɔn asafo suntidua; 33#1 Ko 9.20-22 sɛdeɛ me nso mehwehwɛ sɛ mesɔ nnipa nyinaa ani, nnoɔma nyinaa mu, na menhwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ma me nko ara, na mmom deɛ ɛyɛ ma dodoɔ no, na ebia wɔagye wɔn nkwa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Anuanom, mempɛ sɛ mede sie mo sɛ yɛn agyanom nyinaa hyɛɛ mununkum no ase, na wɔn nyinaa faa ɛpo no mu, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa asu too Mose so, mununkum ne ɛpo no mu, na wɔn nyinaa dii honhom fam aduane korɔ, na wɔn nyinaa nom honhom fam anonneɛ korɔ, na wɔnom firii honhom fam botan a na ɛdi wɔn akyire no mu; na ɔbotan no ne Kristo.
Nanso wɔn mu fa kɛseɛ no ara ansɔ Nyankopɔn ani; na wɔdwɛree wɔn serɛ so hɔ. Na wɔde yeinom ayɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama yɛn, na yɛn kɔn annɔ bɔne sɛdeɛ wɔn kɔn dɔeɛ no. Afei monnyɛ abosonsomfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom yɛeɛ no, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Nkurɔfoɔ no tenaa ase didii, nomee, na wɔsɔre goroe. Nso mommma yɛmmmɔ adwaman sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom bɔeɛ na wɔn mu mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa totɔɔ da koro no. Nso mommma yɛnnsɔ Kristo nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom yɛeɛ, na awɔ kunkumm wɔn no. Nso monnnwiinwii sɛdeɛ wɔn mu binom nwiinwiiɛ na ɔsɛefoɔ no bɛsɛee wɔn no. Na yeinom nyinaa siiɛ, na ayɛ kɔkɔbɔ ama wɔn, na wɔatwerɛ no sɛ afotuo ama yɛn a wiase berɛ awieeɛ ato yɛn yi.
Enti deɛ ɛyɛ no sɛ ɔgyina hɔ no nhwɛ yie na wanhwe ase. Sɔhwɛ biara ntoo mo, gye deɛ ɛyɛ nipa deɛ; na Onyankopɔn yɛ nokwafoɔ a ɔremma wɔnsɔ mo nhwɛ mmoro deɛ mobɛtumi soɔ, na mmom ɔbɛma kwan a mode bɛfiri sɔhwɛ no mu abɛda ho, na moatumi agyina.
Enti, m’adɔfo, monnwane mfiri abosonsom ho, Mene mo kasa sɛ animdefoɔ. Mommu deɛ mereka yi ho atɛn. Nhyira kuruwa a yɛhyira soɔ no nyɛ Kristo mogya no ayɔnkoyɛ anaa? Paanoo a yɛbubuo no nyɛ Kristo nipadua ayɔnkoyɛ anaa?
Ɛnam sɛ paanoo no yɛ baako nti yɛn a yɛyɛ bebree no yɛ nipadua baako; na yɛn nyinaa di paanoo baako no bi. Monhwɛ honam fam Israel; ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔdi afɔdeɛ aduane no na wɔne afɔrebukyia no wɔ ayɔnkoyɛ anaa? Afei mese deɛn? Sɛ abosom afɔdeɛ yɛ biribie anaasɛ ɔbosom yɛ biribie? Dabi, na mmom mese, afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ no, wɔbɔ ma ahonhommɔne, na ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn, na mempɛ sɛ mo ne ahonhommɔne nya ayɔnkoyɛ. Montumi nnom Awurade kuruwa ano ne ahonhommɔne kuruwa ano; montumi nnidi Awurade pono so ne ahonhommɔne pono so. Anaasɛ yɛrehyɛ Awurade ama no atwe ninkunu anaa? Yɛn ho yɛ den kyɛne no anaa?

Nnoɔma nyinaa ho da kwan, na ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na ɛboa; nnoɔma nyinaa ho da kwan, na ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa na ɛma nkɔsoɔ. Obiara nnhwehwɛ ɔno ara ne yiedie, na mmom ɔnhwehwɛ ne yɔnko yiedie. Deɛ wɔtɔn no namdwa ase nyinaa, monni, na ahonim nti mommmisabisa ho asɛm! Na asase ne deɛ ahyɛ so ma nyinaa yɛ Awurade dea. Na sɛ wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no mu bi hyia mo adidi, na mopɛ sɛ mokorɔ a, deɛ wɔde bɛsi mo anim biara, monni, na ahonim nti, mommmisabisa ho asɛm! Na sɛ obi se mo sɛ: Yei yɛ ɔbosom afɔdeɛ a, deɛ ɔkyerɛeɛ no ne ahonim nti, monnni. Sɛ meka sɛ ahonim a, nyɛ wo deɛ, na mene onii no deɛ; na adɛn na obi ahonim bɛbu me ahofadie atɛn? Na sɛ mede aseda medi a, adɛn nti na wɔbɛbɔ me dimmɔne deɛ meda ɛso aseɛ ho? Enti sɛ modidi oo, monom oo, moyɛ biribiara oo, monyɛ ne nyinaa nhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.

Monnyɛ deɛ ɛto Yudafoɔ anaa Helafoɔ anaa Nyankopɔn asafo suntidua; sɛdeɛ me nso mehwehwɛ sɛ mesɔ nnipa nyinaa ani, nnoɔma nyinaa mu, na menhwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ma me nko ara, na mmom deɛ ɛyɛ ma dodoɔ no, na ebia wɔagye wɔn nkwa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
